title: UPDATE: Scott Wiener Wins Nancy Pelosi's House Seat With Plan for National AI Regulator
summary:
State Senator Scott Wiener will bring a legislative focus on artificial intelligence regulation to the U.S. House after the Associated Press confirmed his victory in California's 11th Congressional District. Wiener intends to pursue the establishment of a federal AI regulator and the expansion of unemployment insurance to mitigate job losses caused by AI, goals he campaigned on to bring his state-level safety laws to a national scale.

The result puts the author of California's AI safety law SB 53 in Congress, following a history of regulatory disputes with tech firms including OpenAI, Meta, Google and Andreessen Horowitz. Wiener won the San Francisco-based seat by defeating fellow Democrat Connie Chan, who had received the endorsement of the seat's long-term holder and former Speaker Nancy Pelosi.
